tasks.title: Metrics module
tasks.brief: Create backend/metrics.py with pure functions over a list of Word(text, start, end) in seconds: words_per_minute, find_pauses(min_gap=1.5) returning (at, length) tuples, count_fillers returning per-word counts for um/uh/hmm/like/you know/so/basically/actually (phrase 'you know' counts as one), find_repeats (immediate repeats and restarts like 'and I, uh, and I'), pace_windows(window=10s) returning wpm per window, and analyze(words) returning a dict with all of these plus duration and word_count. Load backend/tests/fixtures/test_clip_assemblyai.json in tests; the fixture has 6 um, 3 uh, and three pauses over 1.5 s. Add hand-made word lists for edge cases: empty list, single word, pause at start.
tasks.acceptance: backend/tests/test_metrics.py exists with at least 10 tests covering every function, all pass; analyze() on the fixture returns filler counts um=6 uh=3 and exactly 3 pauses >= 1.5 s.

tasks.title: Provider abstraction
tasks.brief: Create backend/providers/ with base.py defining Word dataclass and a transcribe(audio_bytes, content_type) -> list[Word] protocol; assemblyai.py (upload, create transcript with disfluencies=true, poll until completed, map ms to seconds); deepgram.py (nova-3 with filler_words=true). get_provider() reads STT_PROVIDER env var, default assemblyai. Use httpx. Tests mock httpx with respx or monkeypatching; no network.
tasks.acceptance: backend/tests/test_providers.py passes with network blocked; both providers return list[Word] from recorded sample responses; get_provider() selects by env var.

tasks.title: Analyze endpoint
tasks.brief: Add POST /api/analyze to backend/app.py accepting multipart audio (field 'audio'), calling get_provider().transcribe then metrics.analyze, returning JSON {transcript: [words], metrics: {...}}. Reject empty files and recordings under 5 s with 400 and a clear message. Audio must only live in memory; never write it to disk. Map provider failures to 502 with a friendly message.
tasks.acceptance: backend/tests/test_api.py covers success (provider mocked), empty upload, too-short recording, and provider failure; all pass.

tasks.title: Practice screen: record and submit
tasks.brief: In frontend/, build the practice screen: choose one of three built-in reading passages or a free-talk prompt, big record button, elapsed timer, stop, then upload to /api/analyze and show the JSON result in a simple results panel. Use MediaRecorder; request mic permission on button press, not on page load. Show clear states: idle, recording, uploading, error (mic denied, network). Mobile-first layout, 16px gutters, no horizontal scroll.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: on localhost in Chrome, a 10 s recording round-trips and shows wpm and filler counts. frontend/app.js has no global leaks beyond `app`. ruff and pytest still pass.

tasks.title: Results screen
tasks.brief: Replace the raw JSON panel with a designed results screen: metric cards (wpm, fillers per minute, pauses, longest pause), transcript with filler words highlighted and pause markers inline, and one or two rule-based tips chosen from a small table in frontend/tips.js (e.g. wpm > 180 -> slow down; fillers/min > 6 -> pause instead of um). Clean, consistent styling in styles.css with CSS variables and dark-mode support.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: results render correctly for the fixture clip; tips change when metrics change (unit test the tip selection in a tiny JS test run with node, or document the manual check).

tasks.title: Session history in IndexedDB
tasks.brief: Save each completed session (date, passage name, metrics, transcript) to IndexedDB in frontend/store.js. Add a History screen listing sessions newest first with date, passage, wpm and fillers per minute; tapping one reopens its results. Add delete for a single session. No audio is stored.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: a session survives reload; history lists it; delete removes it. store.js exposes save, list, get, remove.

tasks.title: Progress chart
tasks.brief: Add a Progress screen with a hand-rolled SVG line chart (no chart library) of wpm, fillers per minute and pause count over sessions, with a toggle between metrics, axis labels, and a readable empty state when fewer than 2 sessions exist.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: with 5 saved sessions the chart renders three series correctly and scales to phone width.

tasks.title: Browser-side pause detection with Web Audio
tasks.brief: HUMAN-OWNED. Ares writes this by hand: sample RMS energy during recording with an AnalyserNode, detect silences over 1.5 s with an adaptive threshold, and reconcile with transcript gaps.

tasks.title: Render deployment
tasks.brief: Add render.yaml for a free web service running uvicorn on $PORT, a start command, and a README section on deploying. Add a /api/health check path to the config. Ensure static files are served with correct cache headers for the PWA.
tasks.acceptance: render.yaml validates (documented manually); README deploy section complete; tests pass.

tasks.title: PWA manifest and onboarding
tasks.brief: Add manifest.json, icons (simple SVG-derived PNGs generated by a script in scripts/), a minimal service worker that caches the app shell only (never API responses), and a one-screen onboarding on first launch explaining what the app measures and that audio is deleted after analysis.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: installable on iPhone Safari and Android Chrome; onboarding shows once; tests pass.

tasks.title: Error, empty and loading states pass
tasks.brief: Audit every screen for: mic permission denied, network down, provider 502, empty history, chart with under 2 sessions, upload in progress. Each gets a designed state with a one-line explanation and a retry or next action. Add a small frontend/ui.js helper for showing states consistently.
tasks.acceptance: Manual: each state can be triggered (document how in frontend/README.md) and looks intentional on phone width; tests pass.

tasks.title: Passages and tips content
tasks.brief: Expand frontend/passages.js to six passages (two short debate-style rebuttal paragraphs, two persuasive speech excerpts in the public domain, two tongue-twister style clarity drills) each with a target wpm range. Expand frontend/tips.js to at least 8 rules with thresholds documented in comments.
tasks.acceptance: Passages render in the picker with target wpm shown; tip rules documented; tests pass.

tasks.title: Repo polish for judges
tasks.brief: Add docstrings to every backend function, a short comment header to each frontend module, a frontend/README.md describing module responsibilities, and update README.md sections: screenshots placeholder list, setup, deploy, tests, AI disclosure link. Do not change behavior.
tasks.acceptance: ruff passes; pytest passes; README setup steps work from a fresh clone (describe the check).
